subject: Request for Pollination Contract for Sierra Crest Orchard
body_text:
Hi there! 

I hope this message finds you well. I’m reaching out to finalize our pollination contract for the upcoming almond bloom at Sierra Crest Orchard, just like last year. We’ll need 30 hives delivered to Block A starting around February 15th, with expectations of peak bloom around the 20th. If possible, could we arrange for a split delivery to ease the setup? 

Looking forward to your prompt reply so we can get everything in place. Thanks! 

Best,  
Gabriel Juarez

subject: Inquiry about Pollination Services and Pricing
body_text:
Hi there! 

I’m exploring options for our upcoming pollination needs and wanted to know more about your services. Could you provide some insight into your pricing structure and availability? We work with a variety of crops, so any details on specific pollination options would be helpful. 

Looking forward to your response! 

Best,  
Anthony Everett  
Cascadia Honey Co.
